a.lede: On this day in 2001, Apple CEO Steve Jobs unveiled the original iPod. He began the presentation by teasing 'a breakthrough digital device that’s not a Mac.'
a.title: The original Apple iPod debuted 25 years ago today

b.lede: Apple's "Pro and Tell" event is taking place in Los Angeles and will likely feature the first touchscreen Mac.
b.title: Apple is set to hold another product event on October 28
